messages:
alex: quick thought — I pushed a tiny prototype for a per-route QuickSwitch in Console that shows routing policy, estimated quota delta, and a telemetry sample preview. link: https://redwood.internal/docs/console/quickswitch :eyes:

morgan: saw it, nice start. question: when QuickSwitch toggles a different model, do we surface model-level pins and their scope? (route-only vs org-wide)

sara: we should show pins but clearly label scope. also add a small cost badge if model cost > current model :moneybag:

pranav: +1 on cost badge. also need a 1-line explanation of sample size for telemetry previews. right now prototype uses 1% sample which hides variance. maybe show "est. latency (1% sample)"

alex: good call. UX idea: three compact chips — Model (name + pin badge), Routing (policy name), Cost delta — clicking any opens full preview pane. minimal friction.

morgan: implementation Q: should the QuickSwitch call the existing /routes/:id/preview API or a new endpoint that returns routing+quota+telemetry in one payload?

sara: prefer a single endpoint to avoid waterfall requests. payload can be shape: {"model":..., "routing":..., "quota":..., "telemetry_preview":...} (we can keep it small)

pranav: keep in mind Dedicated customers may have routing overrides (region pins) that aren't safe to show in quick UI without a warning. add a tooltip: "Overrides present — see full route config" :warning:

alex: implementation sketch in the prototype:
```
GET /api/v1/routes/OLR-123/preview?model=t5-xxl&sample=0.01
Response: {
  model: { id: "t5-xxl", pinned: true, pin_scope: "route" },
  routing: { policy: "latency-first", region: "us-west-2" },
  quota: { est_tokens_per_call: 120, delta_monthly_cost: "$1.2k" },
  telemetry_preview: { sample_pct: 1, avg_latency_ms: 120 }
}
```

morgan: that looks fine. let's add a field telemetry_confidence so we can show a tiny hint if sample is too small.

sara: UX copy: when cost delta > 100% show red text and a CTA: "Compare outputs" so pm/dev can validate quality before committing.

pranav: ops note — feature-flag this behind ff-console-quickswitch. deploy-bot: can we turn on staging for team/product?

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to staging for feature/console-quickswitch at 2024-11-03T18:12Z :rocket:

alex: thanks — I'll update prototype with telemetry_confidence and the cost CTA. can we add a small audit event when user accepts the QuickSwitch (for rollouts tracking)?

morgan: yes, emit event `console.quickswitch.apply` with route_id, old_model, new_model, actor. we'll wire to analytics.

sara: one more: retention for telemetry_preview should be short (7d) to avoid storage bloat.

pranav: noted. next steps: alex to update UI mock + API contract, morgan to scope backend endpoint, sara to draft UX copy for cost/confidence states. ping here when PRs ready. :thumbsup:
